content:
At John Street Square Light Rail Lift between Harvey St and the Light Rail stop is temporarily out of service.
The lift at John Street Square light rail stop on the L1 Dulwich Hill Line towards city is temporarily out of service until further notice.

For your safety, do not use even if the doors open.

Alternative access:
·                     Use the stairs if able to,
·                     Or use the opposite accessible entry/exit pathway via Jack Shanahan Park.
 
For urgent assistance:
Use the Help Point if on the platform
Or call 131 500
